title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A hands-on guide to writing readable, maintainable code, packed with principles and practices for good software craftsmanship.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
description: A classic guide packed with practical tips and philosophies for becoming a more effective, adaptable software developer.

title: Design Patterns
author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides
description: The foundational catalog of object-oriented design patterns, showing how to solve recurring software design problems with reusable solutions.

title: Refactoring
author: Martin Fowler
description: A catalog of techniques for improving the design of existing code without changing its external behavior.

title: Domain-Driven Design
author: Eric Evans
description: Introduces a design approach for tackling complex software by modeling it closely around the business domain.

title: Effective Java
author: Joshua Bloch
description: A collection of best practices and idioms for writing clear, correct, and efficient Java code.

title: You Don't Know JS: Scope & Closures- ou Don't Know JS: Scope & Closures
author: Kyle Simpson
description: A deep dive into the core mechanisms of JavaScript, exploring scope, closures, and how the language really works under the hood.

title: Head First Design Patterns
author: Eric Freeman & Elisabeth Robson
description: An engaging, visually rich introduction to object-oriented design patterns using real-world examples.

author: George Orwell
description: A chilling vision of a totalitarian future where the Party watches everything and independent thought is the ultimate crime.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A young girl in the Depression-era South comes of age as her father defends a Black man falsely accused of a crime.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A witty, sharply observed romance following Elizabeth Bennet's clashes and eventual courtship with the proud Mr. Darcy.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A reluctant hobbit is swept into an epic quest to reclaim a dwarf kingdom from a fearsome dragon.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: An orphaned boy discovers he's a wizard and begins his first year at a magical school full of wonder and danger.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: A young heir navigates politics, prophecy, and survival on a harsh desert planet that holds the galaxy's most valuable resource.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars must use ingenuity and science to survive until rescue is possible.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: A woman vanishes on her wedding anniversary, and the ensuing investigation unravels a twisted portrait of a marriage.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant, troubled hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance in a wealthy Swedish family.

title: The Notebook
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: A tender story of a love that spans decades, tested by class differences, war, and time itself.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
description: A memoir of growing up in a strict, isolated household and the transformative, costly power of education.

title: Steve Jobs
author: Walter Isaacson
description: The definitive biography of Apple's co-founder, drawn from candid interviews with Jobs and those who knew him best.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones through small, consistent changes.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A sweeping look at how Homo sapiens came to dominate the planet, from the cognitive revolution to the modern age.

title: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
description: The powerful, personal diary of a Jewish teenager hiding from the Nazis during World War II.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
description: Two teenagers with cancer fall in love and confront mortality with humor, honesty, and heart.

title: It
author: Stephen King
description: A group of childhood friends must confront an ancient, shape-shifting evil that preys on their small town.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A mysterious millionaire's obsession with a lost love unravels amid the glittering excess of the Jazz Age.

title: Charlotte's Web
author: E.B. White
description: A gentle story of friendship between a pig and a barn spider who works to save his life.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
description: A disaffected teenager wanders New York City, wrestling with alienation, identity, and growing up.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
description: The multigenerational saga of the Buendía family in the mythical town of Macondo, a landmark of magical realism.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: Moments after Earth is demolished for a hyperspace bypass, an unwitting human is swept into a hilarious galactic misadventure.
